canonicalFacts.statement: Data/Item/ItemDrop.txt is a real file present in Blood Moon's actual server distribution.
Blood Moon's real ItemDrop.txt header row has 4 separate DropRate columns named DropRate_AL0, DropRate_AL1, DropRate_AL2, DropRate_AL3 (one per account/VIP tier), not a single DropRate column.

All 92 data lines in Blood Moon's real ItemDrop.txt are commented out (prefixed //), and every DropRate_AL0..AL3 value shown is 0 -- the per-item VIP drop-rate table is entirely inert/unused on Blood Moon.
The ProjectGamers/eMuGS vendor engine added 4 VIP-tier DropRate columns to ItemDrop.txt (replacing a single DropRate column) in an update the vendor labeled 7.0.
Custom Bot Store is a static NPC that sells a fixed list of items for zen and/or Cash, configured via Data/Custom/ text files.
Custom Bot Trader exchanges one player item for a fixed, pre-configured reward item, gated by a configurable success-rate percentage; on failure the input item is lost with no refund.
Custom Bot Trader supports a maximum of 30 bot instances of that type per server.
canonicalFacts.confidence: CONFIRMED_RUNTIME (comment present) / CONFIRMED_VENDOR_VIDEO (30 is the actual enforced max, not just documented)

canonicalFacts.statement: Custom Bot Fusion transfers Luck/Skill/Excellent-option rolls from a source item to a target item, at a configurable success rate; on success the source item loses its transferred options.

Custom Bot Fusion's real config field is named OnlySameType (not 'BotIndexOnly' as this sweep's initial transcript-based normalization guessed) -- when 1, restricts fusion to items of the same equipment category (e.g. sword-with-sword only); when 0, any category may be mixed. A separate DestinyLower flag additionally restricts fusion to cases where the destination item's level is within +/-10 of the source item's level.

The vendor's GameMaster.txt file has a Section 1 (in addition to the existing GM-commands Section 0) that whitelists specific account logins, by account level, for access to a specific Game Server instance.

Blood Moon's real Data/Custom/CustomBotBuffer.txt has its entire bot-placement table (section 1) commented out -- zero active buffer-bot entries, even though the cost/item-requirement/skill sections (2-4) below it are fully configured with 6 class-specific buffer templates (SM/BK/ELF/DL/SUM/RF).

Of the 4 vendor static-NPC bot systems present on Blood Moon (Store, Trader, Fusion, Buffer), only CustomBotStore is currently deployed active (1 live NPC, 'Luffen', a cash shop in Lorencia). Trader, Fusion, and Buffer all exist as configured files but have zero active/enabled entries.

Update 6.8 extends the EventItemBag end-of-event drop mechanism (already used by Blood Castle and Illusion Temple) to Devil Square, adding 7 configurable sub-indices (one per Devil Square level/stage).

Update 6.9 adds 'Reward Level' and 'Reward Points' columns to CustomMonster.txt, letting a specific monster grant direct character levels or a custom points currency on kill, in addition to the pre-existing Quest/GoblinPoint/Reset/MasterReset reward columns.

Across every vendor-provided Data/Custom system independently verified against Blood Moon's real config so far (ItemDrop.txt, CustomBotTrader.txt, CustomBotFusion.txt, CustomBotBuffer.txt, CustomMonster.txt), the file is present with the correct/current column structure but every configured data row is commented out or Enabled=0 -- only CustomBotStore.txt (CLAIM-006/017) is an exception, with 1 genuinely active entry.

Blood Moon's real Data/EventItemBagManager.txt (150 lines) is a flat index mapping 148 reward-bag entries to ItemIndex/ItemLevel/MonsterClass/SpecialValue/DropMap criteria, each referencing an individually-named file in a separate Data/EventItemBag/ folder (also 148 files, indices 000-147).

All 7 custom monster indices in Data/Custom/CustomMonster.txt (275, 361, 459, 561, 295, 801, 802) can be identified by name via cross-reference with EventItemBagManager.txt's MonsterClass column: Kundun, Nightmare, Selupan, Medusa, Erohim, Boss Farao, and Boss BloodMoon respectively.

Data/EventItemBag/147 - Boss BloodMoon.txt (MonsterClass 802) is a byte-identical copy of Data/EventItemBag/146 - Boss Farao.txt (MonsterClass 801), including an internal EventName field that still reads "Boss Farao" and an empty item-reward section (zero items configured to drop from either boss).

Blood Moon's real Data/Custom/CustomEventZombie.txt configures a daily 02:45 event (10-minute duration) with 4 monster waves (indices 14, 15, 55, 515) on Map 1, a 100%-rate cure-item drop (Type 14, Index 8) at the same coordinates as wave 3's spawn point, a Cash/Gold/PcPoint reward, and an entry NPC (class 380) on Map 0.

Blood Moon's real Data/Custom/CustomEventPandora.txt configures a daily 20:00 'Pandora Event' on Map 40 for 2-20 players of any class, where players' skins change to MonsterClass 55 (Skeleton King), in a bounded area, rewarding 100 Cash.

Blood Moon's real Data/Custom/CustomEventStopOrDie.txt configures a red-light/green-light style event on Map 1 with a 60s lobby, 30s countdown, randomized 4-8 second move windows, a 900ms stop-grace period, and a 500/500/500 Cash/Gold/PcPoint reward, entered via an NPC (class 684) at Map 1 coordinates (22,41).

4 entries in EventItemBagManager.txt (indices 102-105, Shining/Elegant/Steel/Old Jewelry Case) are commented out with a leading //, disabling them at the index-table level, even though their corresponding individual Data/EventItemBag/102-105 *.txt files still exist on disk.
